detail_of_failure: The machine does not travel straight.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Monitoring code Travel PPC pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01882)

steps.cause: Pressure compensation valve on the right FORWARD side of the travel control valve
steps.procedure: 1. Do the troubleshooting. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Examine and Adjust Oil Pressure in Work Equipment, Swing, and Travel Circuits”. 2. Does the troubleshooting result agree with the standard value? 3. Stop the engine. 4. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 5. If an abnormality is found in the troubleshooting result, interchange the pressure compensation valves on the right FORWARD side and right RE- VERSE side of the right travel control valve to do the troubleshooting. 6. Is there no change, and does the phenomenon reproduce?
